headline: Discussed Champlain Housing Trust's shared equity homeownership program and ZA-27-03 natural communities and tree ordinance amendment.
summary: Champlain Housing Trust staff presented their Shared Equity Program and answered councilors' questions. A public commenter asked whether the state has verification specialists and who would bear the cost of the ZA-27-03 amendment. The item returns on November 19, 2026, so it can still reach City Council by December 7, 2026.
decisions: Continued the ZA-27-03 natural communities ordinance amendment to the November 19, 2026 committee agenda, unanimously.

plain_text:
Ordinance Committee 
Friday, November 6, 2026 
Bushor Conference Room, City Hall 
or Remote via Zoom. Burlington, Vermont 
DRAFT MINUTES 
 
Members Present: Councilor Bergman (Chair), Councilor Barlow, Councilor Carpenter 
 
Staff Present: Kim Sturtevant (Assistant City Attorney), Michael Monte (Chief Executive 
Officer of Champlain Housing Trust), Julie Curtin (Director of Homeownership at Champlain 
Housing Trust), Sarah Morgan (Principal Planner, Planning Department), Scott Gustin (Zoning 
Division Manager, Zoning Division).  
 
Public Present: Sharon Bushor  
 
Meeting called to order at 2:06 pm 
 
1. Adopt the Agenda 
1.01 Adopt the Agenda 
 
Motion to Adopt Agenda. 
 
Motion by Councilor Carpenter, Seconded by Councilor Barlow 
Final Resolution: Motion Passes 
Yes: Unanimous 
 
2. Adopt Draft Minutes 
2.01 Adopt Draft Minutes from October 28, 2026 
 
Motion to Adopt minutes October 28, 2026. 
 
Motion by Councilor Carpenter, Seconded by Councilor Barlow 
Final Resolution: Motion Passes 
Yes: Unanimous 
 
3. Public Forum 
3.01 Verbal Comments 
 
Sharon Bushor commented that she was attending to listen about affordability etc. Said she had 
some comments about the Natural Communities Amendment, would wait until that portion of the 
meeting.
4. Discussion of Homeownership and Perpetual Affordability including 
Presentation by Champlain Housing Trust 
4.01. Discussion of Homeownership and Perpetual Affordability including 
presentation by Champlain Housing Trust 
 
Julie Curtin Presented on Champlain Housing Trust’s Shared Equity Program. Michael Monte 
and Julie Curtin took questions from councilors about the program.  
 
5. Proposed Ordinance Amendment ZA-27-03 Natural Communities, RTE 
Species, and Specimen Trees 
5.01 Proposed Ordinance Amendment ZA-27-03 Natural Communities, RTE 
Species, and Specimen Trees 
 
Public comment was re-opened. Sharon Bushor asked questions about whether the state has a 
field of “verification specialists”. Asked for clarity on who bears the financial cost. Wants to 
understand what the limitations of the ordinance are.  
 
Sarah Morgan and Scott Gustin presented on ZA-27-03. Sarah Morgan and Scott Gustin took 
questions from councilors.  
 
Councilors and Attorney Sturtevant confirmed that this will be re-visited on November 19, 2026 
so it can still go to City Council by December 7, 2026.  
 
Motion to put this item on the Ordinance Committee agenda for November 19, 2026 
 
Final Resolution: Motion Passes 
Yes: Unanimous 
 
6. Old/New Business 
 6.01 Staff report on status of follow-up on E-motos 
Attorney Sturtevant provided brief update on E-moto item. 
 
 6.02 Plan for Ordinance Amendment Regarding Vegetation, BCO Chapter 29 
Scott Gustin provided brief update on ordinance.  
 
7. Adjournment 
 7.1. Motion to adjourn 
 
The meeting was adjourned with no objection by Chair Bergman at 4:18 pm.
